notes.title: Patch V1.3 is now available! (Add ASSIST MODE)
notes.notes:
HELLO!

Patch v1.3 is now available.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37940549/e3391d23baa7d91876d43a697aca645fdc651957.png
You can check it on title screen.

ADD ASSIST MODE/h2] 

There are a lot of feedback about the difficulty of repair.

We add 'ASSIST MODE' to help repair when you fill too tired during repairing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37940549/6811c9624e282b7a3f6fad88be03f2edddc06715.png

When ASSIST MODE is on, a button appears. You can use it by clicking it.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37940549/e17349ea13f36d68a7e69c71e56ec51218f29479.png

You can activate it by Option, or config command.

BUG FIX
These achievement was not applied. Now it is back to normal. It will be applied when you start a game and clear one stage of EXPLOIT.

   * Complete additional recovery of EXPLOIT
   * Complete additional recovery of DECIPHER

ABOUT EXPLOIT
 * Remove the count limitation of Checkpoint (in DEV_MODE), and recover HP when activate checkpoint.
 * Modify 5 Stage design (a little)
 
I read all reviews. Reviews help me make this patch. I reply all reviews about assist mode and checkpoint (defrag) 

Thank You!

notes.title: 1.1.3 Update! (Critical Bug in some region fix)
notes.notes:
We notice critical region issue by this review. https://steamcommunity.com/id/10L0ve/recommended/1173110/

We targeted Ko, En, Jp. We could not find this problem.

Our mail check was too late. Sorry for late bug fix. Thank you "100% Love"!

You can report bug or feedback. We always frequently check twitter. 

ps. This bug is related to format of float. Some region use [,] instead of [.] to represent float. It makes error while loading save.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 has been released!
notes.notes:
We are taking a look on issues on reviews, community(twitter) etc.

----IMPORTANT CHANGE!
 - Apply 'skip_intro_message' setting by default.
   - Many people says, "Console Intro is too slow!"
   - You can skip it by using `config` command. but it is not default.
   - we decided to it skipped as default (after some progress passed)
 - Fix Level design of Defrag-2, Exploit-2
   - Difficulty improves For Normal Mode only

----Bug Fix
   - FIX : CHECKPOINT Counter does't show in Exploit.
   - FIX : unexpected game shutdown.
   - FIX : Bingo gets stuck sometimes.
   - FIX : adjust UI position in BINGO,


Feedbacks are very helpful for us. We do our best for applying your feedbacks.

Thank you!!!!!!
